items.title: Settle the argument: your club's all-time five on €15M | FAN LIFE Royal Rumble
items.description:
Every fan has had this argument: who makes your club's all-time team? Royal Rumble settles it.

Pick your club. Every player it has ever had is in the deck. Choose a position, three cards land — a premium, a mid-price and a bargain — and you take one. Five-a-side for €15M, or the full eleven for about €35M. Three rerolls for the whole draft. Lock your five and they walk out against another five from your own club, dealt before your first pick — then they play. Send your mate the link: same deck, same budget. Now it's not an argument. It's a result.

items.title: You've shouted at the manager for years. Your turn. | FAN LIFE Legends Manager
items.description:
You've shouted at the manager for years — from the stand, from the sofa, from the pub. Your turn.

Legends Manager: one club, only the men who wore its shirt. Draft seventeen legends from the club's whole history (GK 2 · DF 6 · MF 6 · FW 3) on a budget the board draws with a lever — between €50M and €52M. Before every pick you choose the line; three men are offered — premium, squad and bargain — and three rerolls are yours for the whole draft. Every legend is rated in stars, measured against his own club. Register the squad and the board adds €8M for the first window. Pick the shape, name your captain. Then the season: the quick result, or the touchline — up to three stops a match, three changes, tactics you can turn. Cards, bans and injuries are real and carry on. Two windows a season. Your dynasty.

A signing is a time machine: a fantasy, never a transfer that happened.

▶ Play Legends Manager: https://fanlife.dubelteam.com/all-football/legends
▶ Every club on FAN LIFE: https://fanlife.dubelteam.com
